components.name: semantic_diagnosis_system_prompt
components.text:
You diagnose one semantic defect class in one DCAT-AP+ Dataset draft slice.
Return only JSON matching the supplied diagnosis schema with top-level keys defects and reason.
Each defect must use exactly: defect_type, target_path, entry_indices, recommended_action, needs_synthesis, and reason.
Do not return writes, operations, JSON Patch, action envelopes, replacement values, or profile objects.
Use only the supplied draft excerpt and evidence. Do not invent facts.
For DCAT-AP+ generic attributes, diagnose append/replace only when evidence directly supports a recorded characterization
of the exact parent object. Source-record metadata, creator/owner/origin fields, file paths, process paths,
audit/hash details, provenance bookkeeping, and identifiers for other objects are not parent attributes by default.
Use no_action when the defect is real but the supplied context cannot justify a safe repair.
When a missing target is directly supported by selected evidence, recommend append or replace and set needs_synthesis true.
Any append or replace that needs a new value must set needs_synthesis true.
For dataset description scope, do not remove the only description entry. Recommend replace with synthesis for a streamlined description, or no_action.
For activity evaluation targets, diagnose every generating activity independently and forbid evaluated_activity self-reference.
For range decomposition, diagnose one remove action for the collapsed range entry and append actions with synthesis for separate minimum and maximum attributes.
For attribute parent placement, express a move as an append diagnosis at the correct parent path plus a remove diagnosis at the current parent path.

components.name: system_schema
prompt
components.text:
Diagnose semantic draft defects for this one requirement. Do not write the profile.

{
  "requirement": {
    "requirement_id": "dataset_description_scope",
    "label": "Dataset description scope",
    "description": "Description remains a compact dataset-level summary and does not repeat facts that are already represented as structured activity, agent, plan, target, or attribute fields.",
    "weight": 1.0,
    "target_paths": [
      "/description"
    ],
    "expected_target_class": null,
    "evidence_hints": [
      "dataset description",
      "summary",
      "content",
      "scope"
    ],
    "allow_not_applicable": false,
    "allowed_categories": []
  },
  "assessment": {
    "requirement_id": "dataset_description_scope",
    "status": "partial",
    "quality": 0.5,
    "rationale": "The description includes details about the NMR spectral data, acquisition parameters, processing steps, and file formats. However, it repeats information about the instruments (Bruker NMR spectrometer) and the software (TopSpin) which are already represented as structured activity and agent fields. The description also mentions audit trail and configuration settings, which could be streamlined.",
    "target_paths": [
      "/description"
    ]
  },
  "allowed_target_paths": [
    "/description"
  ],
  "draft_excerpt": {
    "/description": [
      "Dataset subject: NMR spectral data and associated configuration files. Generated by: Automated NMR experiment execution using Bruker TOPSPIN software. Activity target: 1H NMR spectra acquisition and processing. Instruments: Bruker NMR spectrometer (model unspecified). Setting plan: Defined by parameter files (acqu, pulseprogram, format.temp) specifying acquisition sequence, pulse parameters, and frequency settings. Data processing involved TopSpin software for Fourier transformation and baseline correction. Characteristics: Data format includes proprietary binary (fid) and text-based parameter files. Audit trail (audita.txt) records user actions and system configuration. Data files (pdata) contain processed spectral data and intermediate results. File summaries: r1|10/acqu|summary=NMR acquisition parameters. r2|10/pdata/1/proc|fmt=text|summary=NMR processing parameters. r3|10/pdata/1/procs|fmt=text|summary=NMR processing parameters. r4|10/audita.txt|fmt=txt|summary=TOPSPIN audit trail. r5|10/pdata/1/outd|fmt=text|summary=NMR configuration settings. r6|10/format.temp|fmt=text|summary=NMR acquisition parameters. r7|10/pulseprogram|fmt=text|summary=NMR pulse program. r8|10/acqus|summary=NMR acquisition parameters. r9|10/fid|fmt=binary|summary=Raw NMR data. r10|10/fq1list|summary=Signal intensity values."
    ]
  },
  "selected_evidence": [
    {
      "evidence_id": "ev:083d09d288d52994",
      "category": "instrument_signal",
      "role": "identity",
      "claim": "The spectrometer is an Avance III NMR spectrometer.",
      "evidence_text": "Avance III NMR spectrometer",
      "file_path": "10/uxnmr.info",
      "source_context": "Description : CABINET 500 HD OB\nLocation : Karlsruher Institut fuer Technologie Karlsruhe Germany\nSystem : Avance III NMR spectrometer\n1H-frequency : 500.13 MHz\nOrder Number : 10146761"
    },
    {
      "evidence_id": "ev:d3bed3ab435637d4",
      "category": "instrument_signal",
      "role": "descriptor",
      "claim": "The cabinet is a 500 HD OB.",
      "evidence_text": "<CABINET 500 HD OB>",
      "file_path": "10/uxnmr.par",
      "source_context": "##$DRUETH31= <no>\n##$DRUETH32= <no>\n##$Description= <CABINET 500 HD OB>\n##$DppType= 0\n##$FCUMEM= (0..7)"
    }
  ],
  "context_window": [
    {
      "evidence_id": "ev:05f74e5adc4ce3df",
      "category": "resource_signal",
      "role": "descriptor",
      "claim": "The firmware version of the DRU is 170619.",
      "evidence_text": "170619",
      "file_path": "10/uxnmr.info"
    }
  ],
  "diagnosis_rules": [
    "Return only defects[]. Do not return JSON Patch operations or action envelopes.",
    "Use entry_indices only for entries already visible in the target array excerpt.",
    "Set needs_synthesis true only when a new value or object must be generated from evidence.",
    "For append or replace of a missing/incorrect value, set needs_synthesis true unless the value already exists visibly in the draft excerpt.",
    "When selected evidence directly supports a missing required target, prefer append or replace with needs_synthesis true over no_action.",
    "Before recommending an attribute append/replace, silently check that the value characterizes the exact target parent, has clear attribute intent, and is not source-record metadata or provenance context.",
    "Do not recommend creator, owner, origin, vendor/manufacturer, file path, process path, audit/hash, or bookkeeping facts as generic attributes unless evidence says they characterize the target parent itself.",
    "Do not recommend appending creator/publisher/provenance fields from generic origin/owner/source metadata unless evidence explicitly identifies dataset-level responsibility.",
    "Instruments, software, and devices are all valid technical agents; do not diagnose software as invalid merely because it is not a physical instrument.",
    "Use no_action when the requirement is unresolved but no safe repair can be identified.",
    "For dataset description scope, do not remove the only description entry. Use replace with synthesis for a streamlined description, or no_action.",
    "For attribute parent placement, express a move as append at the correct parent path and remove at the current parent path."
  ]
}
